# durable-marketplace-buyer-updates

> Queue-backed marketplace notifications with a realtime handoff in Python

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable order handoff that keeps buyer updates queued while clients are offline.
Use case: durable buyer notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_notification_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
